report_topic: Efficacy of Implementation of 74th Constitutional Amendment Act
observations_summary: The audit found that the 74th Constitutional Amendment Act was not effectively implemented in Rajasthan, with limited devolution of functions to Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), delays in constituting key committees, and significant financial dependence on state grants. ULBs also faced issues with revenue generation, unrealistic budget planning, and high staff vacancies, hindering their ability to deliver services effectively.
